title: He grew up in India, taught at Harvard - and just became one of Asia's top economists.

sources.text: Business Standard - ADB names Karthik Muralidharan chief economist, succeeding Albert Park
American Bazaar - ADB appoints Karthik Muralidharan as Chief Economist

caption:
He grew up in India, taught at Harvard - and just became one of Asia's top economists.

Muralidharan grew up in India before earning degrees at Harvard and Cambridge. He currently holds the Tata Chancellor's Professorship in Economics at UC San Diego and will take charge of ADB's economic research and forecasting for Asia-Pacific starting July 2027.

Muralidharan founded the Centre for Effective Governance of Indian States, which partners with Indian state governments to test and improve public service delivery - the kind of applied research he'll now bring to the entire Asia-Pacific region.

Muralidharan's new role puts someone with hands-on India policy experience in charge of the research that shapes how Asia's biggest development bank sees the region's growth.
